field.label: Subnet
field.help: Kea DHCPv6 subnet to enable DDNS for.

field.label: Qualifying suffix
field.help: FQDN suffix appended to hostnames (e.g. dyn.example.com.). Must end with a dot. Leave blank to use global default.

field.label: Send updates
field.help: Enable sending DDNS updates for this subnet. Leave blank to use global default.

field.label: Update on renew
field.help: Send DNS updates when leases are renewed. Leave blank to use global default.

field.label: Override no-update flag
field.help: Perform DDNS updates even if the client's FQDN option (Option 39 N-bit) asked the server not to. Leave blank to use global default.

field.label: Override client update flag
field.help: Perform the forward DNS update server-side even when the client said it would do it itself. Leave blank to use global default.

field.label: Replace client name
field.help: Controls whether Kea replaces the client-sent FQDN. Leave blank to use global default.

field.label: Conflict resolution
field.help: How to resolve DNS conflicts using DHCID records. Leave blank to use global default.

field.label: Rapid commit
field.help: Enable DHCPv6 Rapid Commit (RFC 8415). Required for macOS clients.

field.label: Generated prefix
field.help: Prefix for auto-generated hostnames when replacing client name. Leave blank to use global default.
